headline: Russian Stocks Close Higher as MOEX Index Advances 1.51%
summary: The Russian equity market finished trading with gains, as the benchmark MOEX Russia Index climbed 1.51% by the close of trade.
why: The MOEX Index tracks major Russian corporations across energy, mining, and finance, reflecting local equity liquidity amidst ongoing sanctions.

impacts.name: MOEX Russia Index
impacts.why: Broad-based buying lifted the Russian benchmark index by 1.51% at market close.

why_moved: Russian equities saw broad-based buying at the close of trading, driving the MOEX Russia Index up 1.51%.
